natural_body: Deep discounts spike signups +31% but risk renewal. Use tactically with guardrails.

first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4%. Memory 91 shows activation messaging improved week-one engagement and first meaningful action. Memory 86 confirms shorter onboarding lifts adoption. Rather than chasing price-sensitive competitors with discounts (memory 73 shows renewal risk) or pursuing referrals (memory 57 works for established cohorts, not new acquisition), activation messaging addresses the immediate metric decline while preserving long-term revenue quality. Verifying memory_31 (simplification lift) and memory_91 (messaging efficacy) provides confidence that messaging-driven activation complements—rather than replaces—the proven onboarding simplification work. This is lower-risk than promotional pricing and targets root cause (engagement drop) rather than symptom (competitive pressure on price). A standard experiment scope tests messaging variants across new and early-stage accounts without broad exposure until results validate.
